caption: The drawing shows a simple, black-outlined vase shape placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. Inside the outline of the vase, there is a depiction of a blue bird perched on a small patch of blue ground. The bird faces toward the right, and both the bird and the ground are rendered in shades of blue, with some darker and lighter areas suggesting shading and volume. The rest of the drawing outside the vase and bird is left blank, with no additional objects or colors present.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
